Former Finance Secretary Questions Official GDP Figures

Former Finance Secretary Subhash Garg has claimed that India's nominal GDP growth is significantly lower than the official figures, stating it is 2.6% instead of the reported 7.8%. Garg's analysis, shared by Satya Hindi, suggests a discrepancy of approximately ₹6 lakh crore. The Lallantop also reported on Garg's claims, questioning whether the true GDP figures are being concealed.
